headline: Vehicle claims from Christine King for $250.00 and Ashley Mazzucco for $281.27.
summary: The meeting covers two vehicle claims, one for a pothole and one for a tire. Two pothole claims, from Branden Dyson and William Samos, are listed to be postponed indefinitely.
